criteria.claim: SNpp16 selectively drives DVM motor neurons, reliably from k=7

protocol.drive: draw d at k recruits k cells chosen with seed SEED_BASE + 17 k + d, each firing one spike per wingbeat cycle at a uniform random phase with gaussian jitter (an 8 mV kick into each afferent), after 200 ms of settling
protocol.R1: k=7 on the targeted transmitter-sign inversion (FLYCNS_SIGNFLIP_TARGETED=1: every neuron whose per-T-bar predictions disagree in sign with its aggregate label, data/edges_nt.parquet); cells seed base 1000, phase seed d
protocol.R2: k=7, one parameter at a time for the relay-layer superclasses (read from the data: superclasses of the excitatory relays onto DLMn c-f, sensory excluded); cells seed base 1000, phase seed d
protocol.R3: k = 1 .. the number of SNpp16 cells with fresh draws: cells seed base 50000, phase seed 50000 + d
protocol.scoring: per draw (stats.per_draw): DVMn 1a-c in band needs 4 of 5 draws (need 0.8, FAIL at most 1); steering, b1 and DLMn c-f below 1 Hz need every draw (need 1.0, FAIL if none)

R1_survives_transmitter_uncertainty.condition: scored only if the inversion flips a connection on the path under test (both ends among the driven SNpp16 cells, the readouts and the relay layer); otherwise UNRESOLVED (stats.unresolved, no band)
R1_survives_transmitter_uncertainty.rule: on the flipped graph at k=7: DVMn 1a-c in 2-12 Hz in at least 4 of 5 draws (first band), and steering MN, b1 MN and DLMn c-f each below 1 Hz in every draw (per_draw need 1.0; the check is strict, per_draw's edge is inclusive) (second band)

R2_selectivity_holds_across_cord_params.condition: scored only if a relay superclass is found in the data; otherwise UNRESOLVED (stats.unresolved, no band)
R2_selectivity_holds_across_cord_params.rule: at every setting of the sweep, k=7: steering MN, b1 MN and DLMn c-f each below 1 Hz in every draw (per_draw need 1.0; the check is strict, per_draw's edge is inclusive)

R3_replicates_with_fresh_draws.rule: with fresh draws, k* is within 1 of 5 (no k below 4 in band and some k in 4..6 in band, 'in band at k' meaning DVMn 1a-c in 2-12 Hz per draw) and DVMn 1a-c at k=7 is in 2-12 Hz in at least 4 of 5 draws

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 45 mV at w_scale 0.4 with the per-GF JON calibration (refit 2026-10-11, cloud run 13, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at exactly 2.0, its limit; 30 mV gives 2.75). Before: 10 mV at w_scale 0.3 (2026-10-10), 30 mV under the all-trials loom input, 15 mV from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 15 spikes per loom (9.7 on average on the strongest-gain quartile).
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020
